derivation_premises: Contents that cannot be reached are not stored, they are sealed in.
obligations.statement: An enclosed volume exists with an opening through which contents can be reached.

derivation_premises: Opening and closing are transitions between two states; without both there is nothing to transition between.
obligations.statement: Two named configurations exist, one giving access to the enclosed volume and one closing it.

derivation_premises: Repeatedly implies the path is available more than once and in both directions.
obligations.statement: A traversable path connects the two configurations in both directions.

derivation_premises: An unconstrained body does not have a repeatable path.
obligations.statement: Whatever moves between the two configurations is carried by a relation that permits exactly the motion required.

derivation_premises: Without retention the closed configuration is not maintained.
obligations.statement: A retaining function holds the closed configuration and can be engaged and released more than once.

derivation_premises: Accidental opening is release without the deliberate action.
obligations.statement: The retaining function does not release under the disturbance of ordinary handling.

derivation_premises: A release the user cannot reach cannot be operated.
If release required opening the product first, opening would require opening.
obligations.statement: A deliberate user action releases the retaining function, and that action is reachable from outside the product.

derivation_premises: A component that leaves is a loose piece the user must manage, which the repeated cycle would then depend on.
obligations.statement: Every component remains attached through the whole open-close cycle.

derivation_premises: A relation named but not embodied is a label, not a mechanism.
obligations.statement: Every relation the product depends on has a physical realization on all participating bodies.

derivation_premises: A part with no path into the partly built product cannot be installed.
obligations.statement: An ordered installation sequence exists in which every part has a clear path in the configuration produced by the preceding steps.

derivation_premises: An unreacted force accelerates the body carrying it.
